title: Huaca del Sol (Moche)
summary: The Huaca del Sol is a huge adobe platform of the Moche culture near Trujillo on Peru's north coast. The Huacas de Moche project says it originally measured about 345 m by 160 m and 40 m high, built with some 140 million adobes. Treasure hunters badly damaged it in the 17th century.

uncertainty.note: No opened page gives the Huaca del Sol's own building dates. Mincetur says the Moche culture developed in the 1st to 7th centuries AD; those bounds are used.
